title: Cost Controller/Business Analyst
description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited operates the Kainantu Gold Mine in the Eastern Highlands Province. Since we launched in 2016, we've grown gold production every year, boosting Papua New Guinea's economy. We take pride in supporting your communities, with nearly 94% of our team members being fellow PNG locals.
Looking ahead, we will significantly increase our gold production in the next three years. This expansion means that K92 is a place for building a stable career, contributing to the community, and being a key part of our success.
About the role
This role is responsible to provide to provide department managers & superintendents with necessary information to be able to control their costs/budgets, month-end financial transaction reviews and to continually improve the business systems and processes within the Department to enhance efficiency, budget compliance and overall cost effectiveness.
Key / Major Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Track daily expenditure and provide daily, weekly, and monthly cost variance analysis reports to all Sections within the Asset Management Department.
Assist in preparing the Department’s end-of-month and quarterly cost reports. This includes detailed commentary explaining both positive and negative variances to budget.
Review invoicing from Contractors and ensure that POs are approved, receipted, and are accurate and paid in a timely manner.
Assist in the preparation of annual (3 year) operating budgets.
Assist in preparation of CERs.
Assist in sourcing quotations and creating Purchase Requisitions for goods and services.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must a bachelor’s degree and/or Graduate Diploma in Business/Business Administration with CPA, CA, CMA or equivalent accounting designation is desirable. You must have a minimum of 5 years experience in a Cost Controller or Business Analyst role – preferably in the mining industry. In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.
Good level of English literacy - sound report writing skills, with use of finance and accounting terminology.
Good level of competency using the MS Office suite (MS Word, MS Excel and MS Power Point).
Familiarity/experience with Pronto ERP – specifically Finance, Supply and Maintenance modules.
Project Management experience – coordinating small projects.
Life at K92
Our core values — Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Safety — are central to our operations and fundamental to our success. K92 upholds a commitment to equal opportunity, striving to ensure that every individual can reach their highest potential without experiencing discrimination.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
We believe in sharing our success with our employees. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer participation in long- and short-term incentive plans. We also offer savings programs, medical assistance, as well as access to our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
If you share our values and are looking for your next career step, come join us on this exciting journey. Submit your application through our website today.
